visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An anthropomorphic dog with a bulldog-like head and a stout human body stands in a cluttered, wood-paneled room. He wears a tan trench coat, a white tank top, green athletic shorts with white stripes, and a light-colored bucket hat. He begins frantically unbuttoning and removing his coat, showing visible creases in his clothes and a slightly disheveled appearance. (2) The character tosses the trench coat and bucket hat aside toward a cluttered shelf on the right. He then clumsily jumps onto a small wooden bed frame positioned on the left, which has a blue patterned mattress and a cluttered area beneath it. He pulls a thick grey duvet over his body, fully immersing himself in the bed. (3) The scene remains static as the character lies under the grey blanket. Suddenly, he shifts under the covers as if reacting to an external cue, and his paw reaches out to grab a glowing blue smartphone from a side table. The glow illuminates his face as he briefly stares at the screen before sitting up in a hurry. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the character at a small sink. He splashes water onto his face with his paws, with visible water droplets hitting his fur and tank top. The sink area is cramped, with a metal pipe visible in the foreground. He rubs his face and neck vigorously to wake up. (5) The character stands back in the center of the room, now wearing the bucket hat and trench coat again. He picks up a brown briefcase from the floor near the bed. He turns away from the camera and walks through a dark doorway at the back of the room, closing it behind him as he exits.
